data.name: LOCOAL
data.description: LOCOAL is a Texas-based waste-to-energy climate-tech company running a biochar pilot plant in Vancouver, Washington. Its Rainmaker induction-pyrolysis platform converts wood waste into biochar, refined syngas for electricity, and bio-oils, while its IMPCT.AI software handles carbon-credit MRV. The company supplies biochar to regional partners such as Symbiosis TX and is a member of the Capital Factory network.
